children: Overview
France micro-turbomachinery maker's H1 2026 revenue rose 32% yr/yr, driven by industrial contracts
EBITDA margin increased to 15.4%, with net profit up 208% yr/yr
Company secured €5.4 mln in EU funding for factory and technology expansion
Outlook
ENOGIA confirms 2026 target of revenue growth above 30% and further EBITDA margin improvement
Company reiterates Turbo 2028 targets: €25 mln revenue and 20% EBITDA margin by 2028
ENOGIA expects positive free cash flow through 2028, excluding Energy as a Service investments
Result Drivers
INDUSTRIAL CONTRACTS - Growth in ORC Modules business, especially from major contracts for hydrogen fuel cell equipment in South Korea, drove revenue gains
PRODUCTION CAPACITY - Commissioning of new Marseille facility tripled production capacity, supporting execution of strategic plan
WORKING CAPITAL & INVESTMENTS - Negative free cash flow resulted from working capital pressures due to delayed customer payments and increased investments in new factory and product development
